tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshogs bdag gtor bsngo dgos 'dod bum bzang bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes su gnang ba dang / man ngag thob pa'i gang zag gis gnas skabs su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas sha khrag dang kha zas sna tshogs ci 'byor pa dang / dar dmar po'i cod paṇa gyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma rin po che'i dbyibs can bshams shing / rang 'byung po 'dul byed dam yi dam gang rung gi bsgom bzlas rgyas bsdus ci rigs par byas la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs nas/ yi dam dang chos skyong che chung gi gtor ma phul ba'i rjes la/ 'di'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing / spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin nor bus mtshan zhing / dar dmar po'i cod paṇa 'phur ba phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na dgra satwa/ mda' chen/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing / bzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa/ phub dang lhan cig mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing / lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol zhing / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dril bu gsil zhing / oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra sa dhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du brjod pas bkug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos te/ de la oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ sa ma ya hoḥzhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs lan gsum mam/ oṃ na mo stu dhi maḥg na pa ti i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag tshogs kyi dbang / /bgegs kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'am/ rgyal ba'i phrin las rnam sprul zhing / /bdud dang bgegs rigs kun bcom nas/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la bstod/ /gang zhig sgrub par byed pa la/ /log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mthong thos tsam du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i/ /tshogs kyi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /byi ru ltar dmar brjid pa'i sku/ /thogs med las grub rig sngags gsung /

/bde chen gnyis med ye shes thugs/ /bde ba'i mchog gis sprul mdzad bstod/ /mchod yon me tog spos mar me/ /dri dang bza' bca' btung dang dgod/ /rgyan dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis/ /mdzes pa'i mchod gtor rgya mtshos mchod/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes nas kyang / /sgrub cing mchod pa 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo/ /gtor ma tsam la 'dis chog pas/ gzhan dang ma 'brel na nongs pa bshags pa la sogs pa 'og bzhin bya/ sngags bzlas par 'dod na/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i gaḥsngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tshangs pa'i gnas nas tshogs bdag 'khor bcas kyis 'dod dgu char bzhin du phab/ yang 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi longs spyod thams cad bsdus/ gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas 'od zer rang la bsdus pas ci bsam yid bzhin du 'grub par mos la/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pa ci 'grub dang / oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes pa snying po bas cung zad nyung ba bzlas/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus kyis bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mchod gtor gzhan dang 'brel na des khyab/ ma 'brel na nongs pa bshags/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bris sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brtan par bya'o/ /zhes tshogs bdag gi gtor bsngo nyung ngu 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtor bsngo dang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la gzhi byas rang gi kha ton du rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i nyin sbyar//
